contract: Procedural ordering for covered host paths, never semantic truth or complete mutation coverage.

cases.claim: A covered first write is denied before an activity route.
Standard readiness cannot use current alignment in the same user turn.
A later collaborator turn opens a prompt-bound write window only after its meaning is explicitly reconciled as accepted.
A new user prompt invalidates unused readiness.
Feedback after an observed implementation write requires explicit response reconciliation, and a changed basis enters recovery.
An unknown shell command receives a one-use token bound to its exact bytes.
A command with a definite mutation classification cannot be relabeled as investigation.
Delegated durable content can use apply_patch without becoming implementation authority.
An approved durable-record transition does not force a duplicate collaborator checkpoint.
A stop after implementation receives one bounded continuation until closure is recorded.
State is bounded and stores hashes or enums instead of raw prompts, commands, evidence, and context.
Unsafe or corrupt persisted state fails closed for covered writes.
A non-applicable exemption cannot authorize publication, external effects, or structural changes.
Common verification commands are classified as verification effects rather than implementation.
A collaborator prompt arriving while a covered implementation call is in flight preserves the pending event and enters recovery.
Implementation readiness cannot absorb structure, dependency, environment, version-control, external, publication, durable-structure, movement, or deletion authority.
A delegated activity requires an observed current capture before readiness and another observed capture after its latest implementation mutation before completion.
A later collaborator prompt invalidates prior delegated-capture freshness, including a capture call that began before that prompt.
A covered write in flight or an implemented activity without a closing disposition cannot be relabeled as another activity.
Route and exemption controls cannot escape an active readiness, implementation, or recovery transition.
Completion cannot race a covered write that has not produced its post-use result.
Effort cannot be lowered and basis cannot move backward inside one active activity lifecycle.
An authority-only checkpoint cannot be promoted into current direction or scenario alignment.
A stop during unresolved recovery receives one bounded continuation and cannot loop indefinitely.
Interrupting an implementation write in flight preserves its identity and enters recovery.
A new collaborator prompt during a sensitive covered write preserves the pending result and enters recovery.
A later prompt cannot erase an exempt write in flight, and clean orientation resumes after its result is observed.
A later collaborator turn is not treated as agreement until its meaning is explicitly reconciled.
Only one covered write may be in flight, and a missing post-use result has an executable conservative recovery path.
A late post-use result cannot silently contradict an earlier failed-no-effect reconciliation.
Verification passed requires current successful evidence after the latest implementation mutation.
Loaded and created activity transitions require concrete record and locator receipts, and an approved creation digest remains bound.
A missing durable store or same-session rationale cannot become a Standard or High no-record exception without a collaborator decision.
Workspace, working-directory, exec, and direct forms of common verification commands are classified without repeated permits.
Stop-hook configuration does not declare unsupported additional context and friendly status messages retain host-native event names.
Spanish and English prompts select a bounded friendly message language without persisting raw prompt text or exposing diagnostic codes in ordinary output.
The portable router recognizes trusted friendly capability headings instead of depending on the removed user-visible PMNM guard prefix.
